purpose.title: Mission
purpose.text: Our mission is to help everyone stay physically fit and mentally well through the practice of yoga.

purpose.title: Vision
purpose.text: Our vision is to make yoga accessible to people of every age, including those managing health conditions, and to support their physical and mental well-being.

purpose.title: Philosophy
purpose.text: We encourage young people to embrace yoga. As the future of our nation, they can build healthy habits, care for their physical and mental well-being, and contribute positively to their communities.

reasons.title: Special Courses
reasons.text: We offer special courses for every age group, focusing on particular topics and methods of yoga practice. Classes can be conducted at different times, so you can choose a schedule that suits you.

reasons.title: Experienced Trainers
reasons.text: Aarav Yoga is known for its experienced, engaging faculty. Our teachers specialise in different areas of yoga and make learning clear, approachable, and convenient.

reasons.title: Affordable Price
reasons.text: Aarav Yoga is a charity-funded trust committed to helping everyone stay fit. We keep our fees minimal and affordable, with charges supporting our charitable purposes.
